{{Quote|Yes, Sir. Specter Two signals primary target has gone on vector seventy-one mark five.|An ''[[Admonitor]]'' [[Officer/Legends|officer]]|<ref name="Command Decision">{{JournalCite|11|Command Decision}}</ref>}}
